audit.summary: The 320×480 ad creative meets all mandatory audit criteria. The layout is clean and well-structured, with proper hierarchy: Peugeot logo top-left, red 'OFFRES PRO' badge top-right, vehicle hero image centered, pagination dots below the vehicle, blue content section with white and red typography, and red CTA button with legal text footer. All colors conform to the Peugeot style guide primary and secondary palettes. Typography is clear and French copy is appropriate. The CTA has sufficient margin from the bottom edge of the ad frame. No blockers detected across initial, animated, and settled states.
audit.regeneration_prompt: No changes required. The creative is audit-approved.
